title: Fix Btrfs space cache v1 deprecation warning
summary: Resolve the warning about deprecated space cache v1 by converting to v2.
error_patterns: space cache v1 is being deprecated

steps.explain: Unmount the Btrfs partition. Replace <PARTITION> with the device path.

placeholders.name: PARTITION
placeholders.description: Device path of the Btrfs partition

steps.explain: Mount the partition with the space_cache=v2 option to trigger the conversion. Replace <PARTITION> and <MOUNT_POINT>.

placeholders.name: PARTITION
placeholders.description: Device path of the Btrfs partition

steps.explain: Unmount the partition again to finalize the conversion.

warnings: After conversion, the filesystem may not be mountable by very old kernels.
Ensure you can boot from a live USB if something goes wrong.

rollback.explain: There is no direct rollback to v1 once v2 is enabled. You would need to restore from a backup.
